'''Xiaodong Zou''' (born 1964) is a Chinese-Swedish chemist who is a professor at [[Stockholm University]]. Her research considers the development of electron diffraction for the three dimensional characterisation of materials. She is a member of the [[Nobel Committee for Chemistry]]. She was elected to the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] and the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]].

== Early life and education ==
Zou was an undergraduate student at [[Peking University]], where she majored in physics. She moved to the [[Beijing University of Technology]] for graduate studies, where she specialised in the physics of metals.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Xiaodong Zou, Stockholm University |url=https://foundry.lbl.gov/2022/01/12/xiaodong-zou-stockholm-university/ |access-date=2022-03-10 |website=foundry.lbl.gov}}</ref> At Beijing, she worked alongside [[K.H. Kuo]], a chemical engineer. She moved to [[Sweden]] as a doctoral researcher, where she worked in structural chemistry at [[Stockholm University]]. Her doctoral research considered electron crystallography and how it could be used to understand inorganic and biological structures.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Revolutionary close-ups of the building blocks of life {{!}} Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation |url=https://kaw.wallenberg.org/en/research/revolutionary-close-ups-building-blocks-life |access-date=2022-03-10 |website=kaw.wallenberg.org |language=en}}</ref> After earning her doctorate, she joined [[Lund University]], where she worked alongside [[David Veblen]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research and career ==
In 1996, Zou joined the faculty at Stockholm University, where she was made professor in 2005.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Xiaodong Zou's Group - Department of Materials and Environmental Chemistry |url=https://www.mmk.su.se/research/research-projects/2.39369/2.39370 |access-date=2022-03-10 |website=www.mmk.su.se |archive-date=2023-04-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230419024451/https://www.mmk.su.se/research/research-projects/2.39369/2.39370 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Her research involves uncovering the atomic structures of nanosized crystals using [[electron crystallography]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Zou |first=Xiaodong |date=2006 |editor-last=Weirich |editor-first=Thomas E. |editor2-last=Lábár |editor2-first=János L. |editor3-last=Zou |editor3-first=Xiaodong |chapter=What is Electron Crystallography? |chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/1-4020-3920-4_1 |title=Electron Crystallography |series=NATO Science Series II: Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry |volume=211 |language=en |location=Dordrecht |publisher=Springer Netherlands |pages=3–16 |doi=10.1007/1-4020-3920-4_1 |bibcode=2006ecna.book....3Z |isbn=978-1-4020-3920-1}}</ref> She has demonstrated that [[transmission electron microscopy]] can be used to determine the structure of zeolites and mesoporous crystals, as well as [[metal–organic framework]]s, [[covalent organic framework]]s and protein microcrystals.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite journal |date=2020-11-16 |title=Xiaodong Zou answers questions about 15 years of research on covalent organic frameworks |journal=Nature Communications |language=en |volume=11 |issue=1 |article-number=5330 |doi=10.1038/s41467-020-19300-z |pmid=33199686 |pmc=7669865 |bibcode=2020NatCo..11.5330. |s2cid=226984929 |issn=2041-1723|doi-access=free }}</ref> She has developed quantitative analysis software to facilitate the analysis of electron microscopy images, with a particular focus on three-dimensional electron diffraction.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite book |last1=Zou |first1=Xiaodong |url=https://oxford.universitypressscholarship.com/10.1093/acprof:oso/9780199580200.001.0001/acprof-9780199580200 |title=Electron Crystallography: Electron Microscopy and Electron Diffraction |last2=Hovmöller |first2=Sven |last3=Oleynikov |first3=Peter |date=2011 |publisher=Oxford University Press |isbn=978-0-19-958020-0 |series=International Union of Crystallography Texts on Crystallography |location=Oxford |doi=10.1093/acprof:oso/9780199580200.001.0001 }}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

Zou launched the Berzelii Center EXSELENT on Porous Materials in 2006, and served as director for 6 years.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Materials, Characterization, and Applications |url=http://www.exselent.su.se/page.php?pid=233 |access-date=2022-03-10 |website=www.exselent.su.se |language=en}}</ref>
